baseline: ea69daf, normal unchanged DSOs and routed model scheduler, one dedicated 24/24 driver
eligibility: Exact match of the real gate split (one node), up/clamp split (two), down then weighting. Check 6-slot/512 dimensions, model weight identities, GPU provider, use counts of gate/up/act, and topology. Enable layers 4 and 24 only in this experiment.
implementation: Borrow each native weight staging destination at its actual split; call installed selective-copy callback on packed valid global IDs; use ordinary CUDA kernels; CPU worker handles singleton FFN from same registered original weights; scatter device results to the original down slots; native weights/slot-order sum, remaining graph, mHC, KV and sampler continue. No second full-size weight arena.
qualification: Native control equals full unmodified model. GP packed-only equal to control, integrated P4/P24 equal to prior one-layer counterfactuals, S and P equal through 16 fixed continuation tokens. Readbacks/hash cross-checks and actual targeted counts for both 512 cases. Timing only after qualification.
primary: Four adjacent O/P pairs per case, O first / P first / P first / O first, prompt order alternates between the two cases. New prefix/empty memory, steady monotonic decode->all final logits ready, no diagnostic tensor readback. First shape/changing shape recorded. Full-model driver, not HTTP TTFT.
also: 24-step free greedy baseline/P, same initial prompt, token IDs and text. No default adoption. Do not extrapolate from 2 layers or 2 fixed prefixes to all layers/contexts/tasks.
